generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. In every subject, tutors increasingly expect you to know when an AI tool helps a task and when it does not, to get useful output from it, and to check that output against the evidence rather than trust it. Treat what follows as being about your own essays, reports and reading, not about study in the abstract.

The same habits carry into working life. Wherever AI tools are part of the job, the people whose work holds up are those who use them with judgement: choosing when a tool fits, directing it well, and checking what it produces. The critical habits you practise here are ones you keep long after you graduate.
